about: Drinks that stay listed but sort to the end of their shelf, never open a first row, never stand in a hero, and never take an office-entry lead. A drink is demoted when any rule matches. name tests 品名; look tests 見た目; vessels limits a rule to those 容器 values. Patterns are case-insensitive. slugs lists drinks judged by eye that the patterns miss.

rules.why: tonic or ginger beer: a mixer, not a drink to hand out
rules.name: トニック|ジンジャー ?ビア|tonic|ginger ?beer

rules.why: styled as a party drink for toasting: シャンメリー and メゾンペリエ シック
rules.name: シャンメリー|メゾンペリエ シック|maison perrier chic
